tei:div.tei:p: "$ (269)༄༅// sbyor drug gegs sel bzhugs/

(270)༄༅// na mo gu ra we/ skabs 'dir zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sgom pa la nyer mkho'i yan lag tu gegs sel gyi man ngag cung zad tsam zhig bshad par bya'o// de la gegs thams cad bsdu na gsum ste/ lus sems gnyis ka la gnod pa bdud kyi gegs dang*/ gtso bor sems la gnod pa ting nge 'dzin gyi gegs dang*/ gtso bor lus la gnod pa 'byung ba lus 'khrugs rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa'i gegs so// de rnams thun mong du sel ba ni/ bla ma'i mos gus dang*/ gang shar sgyu ma lta bur shes pa'i lta ba dang*/ sems can mtha' dag la bcos min gyi snying rje chen po dang*/ sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ tshogs gsog pa la nan tan du byed pa rnams yin pa la/ gegs sel bog 'don thams cad kyi gtso bo ni bla ma'i mos gus kho na ste/ bsags sbyang gi gtso bo yang mos gus kyi sgo nas bla ma'i phyir du dka' spyad byed pa yin cing*/ gegs thams cad mos (271)gus gcig pus rang grol du 'gro ba bya brgya 'ur rdo gcig gis 'ded pa'i tshul du yong bas/ mkhas rloms gang dag bla ma'i mos gus bsgom pa'i lam blun po dang nyi ma'i chos yin par brtsi zhing*/ rang la yon tan phra mo yod pa'i yus kyis bla ma bsten tshul chos nas bshad bzhin mi byed cing man ngag la thob gsha' byed pa'i tshul du dbang che'i spyod pas len par byed pa rnams la ni nyams myong ye mi skye ba'am/ cung zad skyes kyang bar chad kyis 'khyer bar the tshom med do// des na mos gus la sogs pa'i gnas lnga po 'di rnams bor nas/ dmigs pa rlung sbyor lus sbyong sad sud tsam dang*/ dbyug chos dang 'jib ru khab btsag dang me gtar la sogs pa nad bcos than thun res gegs sel zhing bogs thon par re ba ni 'khrul pas 'khrul pa mgo bskor ba yin no// sngar gyi gnad lnga po de tshang ba'i steng nas/ 'byung ba lus 'khrugs yin na bcos phra mo de rnams byas kyang legs (272)par 'gyur ba'i skabs cung zad yod mod/

nyams dang gegs kyi dbye ba ngo ma shes pa dang*/ gegs rang yin kyang skabs 'gar phan las gnod che ba'ang 'byung srid pas nyams myong can gyis legs par brtag pa gal che'o// gegs gsum po de rnams so sor bsrung zhing sel ba ni/ bdud gegs la rgyud sde nas gsungs pa'i bsrung bzlog stong pa nyid dang snying rjes zin pa'i khog nas nyams su blangs pas sel/ spyir na tsha dang mi 'dod pa dang rmi lam ngan pa dang ltas rtsub pa sogs bdud kyi bar chad yin pa'i nges pa med/ rkyen des chos la bar chad che bar song na bdud kyi bar chad yin/ rkyen des chos dang dge ba la bskul/ tha na rim gro tshun chad kyis kyang dge las 'phel/ snying rje nges 'byung mos gus sogs snga phyir je 'phel du 'gro ba byung na dkon mchog gi thugs rjes chos la bskul ma yin/ rmi ltas bzang*/ longs spyod 'phel/ mi kha byams/ gtam snyan/ 'phral skyid kyang dkon mchog gi byin rlabs yin pa'i nges pa med/ de la brten nas chos mi 'phel bar song na bdud kyi bar chad yin/ rang gzhan gyi dge ba gong 'phel du song na dkon mchog gi byin brlabs sam dkar phyogs kyi lha'i mthu yin no// sems kyi gegs sam ting nge 'dzin gyi gegs ni/ bying rgod gnyis dang*/ rnam rtog rgyun chags dang*/ nyon mongs drag po rgyun gcod dka' ba rnams yin pas/ sems byings na/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa dang*/ 'phags pa rnams kyi yon tan dang*/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar dang*/ chos kyi phan yon rnams (273)bsams nas spro ba rgya chen po bskyed de/ rig pa shugs bton nas bsgrim zhing bsgom pas sel/ gzhan yang thun chung ngur bcad/ sa mtho ba dang*/ mthongs dkar ba dang*/ bsil sar bsgom pa dang*/ chu lcag dang*/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la lta ba la sogs pas kyang sel/ kha zas dang spyod lam gyis kyang bsal lo// 'dod yon dran pa sogs rgod pa la 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dang*/

tshe 'di mi rtag pa dang*/ mtho dman 'byor rgud dang*/ 'khor ba'i chos gang la'ang snying po med tshul bsams nas skyo shas drag po bskyed/ shes pa khong glod pa'am rigs gcig la dran pa'i bya ra ba bzhag nas cung zad bsgrim pas sel ba'ang yod/ gzhan yang bying ba sel byed kyi ldog phyogs rnams bsten cing*/ kha zas dang spyod lam gyis kyang bsal lo// rnam rtog rgyun chags ni 'phro ba ngos 'dzin pa dang*/ rnam rtog grangs la 'debs pa dang*/ thun 'phro bcad kyin bcad kyin dran pas bzung bas sel/ rnam g.yeng gi nyes dmigs dang*/ sems gnas pa'i phan yon bsam/ grim lhod spel mar byas te bsgoms na sel ba yin no// de bzhin du nyon mongs so so la so so'i gnyen po ci rigs pa bsten nas dbyings su mnyam par 'jog pa ste/ zhe sdang la snying rje/ 'dod chags la mi gtsang ba/ sred zhen ser sna sogs la nges 'byung sogs so so'i gnyen por mdo rgyud sogs las gsungs pa rnams ci rigs par bsgom pas/ nyon mongs yul dang bcas pa sgyu ma lta bur shes bzhin pas dbyings la (274)mnyam par bzhag na sel bar 'gyur/ 'byung ba lus 'khrugs rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa sel ba la/ dang por nad gdon brtag pa ni/ lte ba'i rtsa 'dab re bzhi dang*/ gsang gnas kyi phyi skor bcu drug ste brgyad bcu las grangs nad bskyed cing de rnams kyi skyon rnams las lus kyi smad lci/ bshang gci'i lam mi bde/ rtsa chu sdoms pa'am dgag dka' ba 'byung*/ sems 'phro zhing gnyis med pa'am chung*/ kha zas bsil ba gnod/ gzhan yang rlung rkyang pa'i nad phal cher yang rtsa de rnams la brten pa yin no// mgrin pa'i rtsa so gnyis dang snying ga'i brgyad de bzhi bcu las mkhris pa dang tsha ba'i nad gtso bor bskyed de rngul che/ skyug stongs 'byung*/ zas kyi ro mi gsal/ gnyid che/ mgo bo lci/ kha zas drod dang bcud gnod/ gtsug tor gyi rtsa 'dab bzhi dang dbral ba'i bcu drug ste nyi shu las tsha grang gnyis kar dang bad kan bskyed de/

bkrag mdangs shong*/ pho ba mi bde/ chu skyur skyug /zas zhu rjes 'pho ba tsha/ lus lci/ rnying pa dang bcud can gnod pa'o// gzhan yang mchin pa la nad yod na/ mig mi gsal zhing na ba dang*/ mkhal ma la yod na rna ba 'on cing rnag sogs 'byung*/ glo ba la yod na snas dri mi tshor bsnabs mang*/ snying la yod na lce mi bde zhing 'brum pa 'byung*/ mtsher pa la yod na reg bya mi gsal zhing khol bur na ba sogs dang*/ rus pa la yod na so sen bkrag med pa dang*/ sha la yod na dreg pa chags shing ba spu log /chu rgyus la yod na rengs 'khum 'byung*/ khrag la yod na chu dmar pa'am ser ba dang*/ lha ba dang sbubs la yod na skra spu gyen du langs pa sogs 'byung ngo*// 'byung ba lus 'khrugs kyi rjes 'brangs ni (275)steng 'og gi gdon gnyis te/ steng gdon la lus sprid/ dran pa rmongs/ rmi lam du mun nag sogs 'byung*/ 'di'i grogs ni rgyal 'gong sogs po gdon rnams kyis byed pa mang*/ 'og gdon ni lus sems lci/ dug gsum 'phel/ lus khol bu khol bur na tsha dang 'brum pa sogs 'byung*/ rmi lam du sdig sprul sogs dud 'gro sna tshogs/ grogs ni mo gdon dang bdud kyis byed pa mang*/ grogs gang yin pa de'i dngos dang rmi lam gyi ltas kyang 'byung ngo*// de rnams bcos thabs la 'byung ba lus 'khrugs spyir sel ba ni gdams ngag 'di nyid kyi man ngag las 'byung ba'i lus spyod rnams yin la/ de dag nyin rer ma chag par byas na sngar yod rnams thon 'gro zhing phyin chad mi 'byung ba yin no// so so'i bcos thabs la srog rtsol gyi skabs dang 'brel bar/ paṇa chen shākya shrī'i man ngag rdo rje'i tshig drug gi 'phros la/ bkag pas 'og sgo btsan thabs su 'gags na steng gi sbyor ba la brten nas dkrol ba ni/ lus gnad gzhan rnams ci bder bcas/ 'og gi 'byed 'dzum gyi spyod pas thur ser 'then glod mang du bya/

rlung ro bsal la steng rlung drag tu rngubs te gsang ba shugs chen pos mnan/ de bas yar 'then te stod du sleb pa tsam na lag pa khu tshur brkyang zhing nu khar brdeg /kha nas hā ring ha thung 'don cing lus 'phar rdeb bya/ dri chu 'gags pa yin na de rjes rlung sngar bzhin bzung la sna bug g.yas nas mang du 'bud/ dri chen dgags pa yin na g.yon nas mang du 'bud do// 'di (276)dang phyogs mtshungs pa gzhan yang bum can bsgom pas thur sel stod du hags pa dang*/ srog rlung thur du lhung ba gnyis 'byung ba 'dra srid/ thul sel glo bur du gyen rgyu'i gnas su sleb na smad kyi drod bsdus/ stod la drod rgyas/ mgo nas rlangs pa 'phyur/ khog nang du shing brjongs pa bzhin no// 'ga' zhig la mgo bo zur zer chen po skye ba'ang yod/ dbugs nang du sdud dka'/ khog nang nas yar rlung phub bskor ba bzhin 'gro ba'i snang ba dang*/ skar khung gi snang ba 'byung ba'ang yod/ de la bcos thabs ni/ phyar ba lta bu'i steng du gan rkyal du brtags nas zur bzhi nas btegs cing*/ rgyab la cung zad brdeb pa yang yang bya/ de nas mgo mdun du bkug la sgal tshig dang po nas gzhug chung gi bar du khu tshur gyis rim pas brdung*/ shugs che chung nad khams dang sbyar/ mar rnying pa'i byug pa dang rkang mthil/ drod dugs bya/ dmigs pa la gnas pa 'dug na bu ga mang po'i sbyor ba dang*/ nor bur thig le nag po la sems gtong du gzhug go /nges sel/ gyen rgyu srog rlung dang bcas pa de thur sel gyi gnas su glo bur du lhub na/ rtsa chu bsdams pa'am 'og sgo sdud mi shes/ rgyu zhabs dang gshang gci'i lam gzer/ stod kyi drod bsdus/ smad lhag par tsha/ de bcos pa ni gcig gis rkang pa nas bzung zhing*/ mgo zhabs slog pa'i tshul gyis mgo sa la ma reg tsam rgyab tu khur/ gcig gis gzhug rug nas ltag pa'i tshigs pa zad pa'i bar bu khu tshur gyis rim pas brdung*/

de nas ras sam snam bu dron mos dkris shing phyi nas (277)bsdams/ yang kha bung spyi rting log tshul du bzhags nas gong bzhin tshigs pa rnams rim pas brdungs/ bu ga mar po'i sbyor ba bsgom thub na legs te des sel/ bum can bsgom pas kor len na tsha byung na dal bus mnye ba dang bu ga gsum pa'i sbyor bas phan/ kor ler 'brum pa dmar tsem byung na dri chu grang mos bkrus pas sel/ gzhan yang mgo bo na ba dang*/ snying 'tshangs pa dang*/ ro stod tsha kram kram pa byung na/ te te brdung pa dang*/ thur sogs la rgyug pa dang*/ dpyangs phrul byas pas kyang phan/ snying ga dang rtsib chung nas yar tsha kreng byung na sked pa yan la las mi 'chol/ 'og rlung drag tu 'then/ brla dang byin pa bsgrim/ rkang sor rnams bskums te rkang pa brkyang bskum mang du byas pas sel/ byang chub kyi sems mi nyams par byed pa'i dngos gzhi ni/ lam gyi dngos gzhi rnams bsgom zhing 'dren 'grems byas pas 'dzag gegs phal cher chod pa yin la/ 'dzag pa'i sgo rnams nas bsrung ba ni/ bshang gci dang bsdongs nas 'chor ba la thig le rul ba rnams nad dang 'dres pa chu dang bsdongs nas 'byung zhing*/ 'ga' zhig la bong bu'i chu 'dra ba 'ong*/ de ni snyigs ma nang du gyur zin pa yin la/ dwangs ma 'chor ba'i rtags su rtsa chu dor bas lus 'dar shig pa dang mgo 'khor ba'am 'gyel tshad pa 'byung*/ de la rlung kha sbyor lte ba nas rgyu zhabs kyi bar du 'then gnon bzhi lnga zhig bya/ rgya mtsho ri rab la gcer pa sogs lus kyi 'gyur ba (278)bzhi dang ldan pas rlung kha sbyor 'then ne'i ngang nas rtsa chu rang 'gros su dor bas phan/ rdul dang sdongs te 'dzag na brod che zhing rdul rtsab ste 'byung*/ de rjes lus zi ldab kyi 'byung zhing stobs chung*/ de la tsan dan dum tsam dri chur btab ste des lus bkru/ de nas mar gyis byug pa byas la sran phye lha bus dril phyis bya/

dmigs pa ba spu'i bu ga thams cad thig le 'od dkar po can gyis gang bar bsam/ so khrag dang sdongs nas 'chor ba ni/ khrag nag por 'dug na nad yin pas ngor/ khrag mtshal kha 'byung zhing mgo zi yor ba dang*/ nyams snang bkrag 'chor ba'i rnam pa byung na zungs khrag dang thig le 'dres pa yin pas mchu btsums pa'i ngang nas lcibs kyis 'jig tshul dang*/ bum can dang ltag pa bskyed pa lhan cig bya/ mchil ma dang lhan cig 'byung ba yang rtags snga ma dang 'dra zhing*/ de la bum can bzung lus sgyed mig btsum byed pa dang res 'ga' spyi bo'i bum can bzung zhing mig nam mkhar bltas pas phan/ sna khrag dang sdongs nas 'dzag pa yang rtags gong dang 'dra/ 'di sgo yangs pas gegs che zhing cung zad sel ba dka'/ khrag gcod kyi man ngag gzhan yang bya/ khyad par bum can gyi ngang nas mtheb 'dzub kyis sna stems/ sna'i rlung nang du drangs zhing mgo sprug /de nas langs te lag pa g.yab g.yug bzhin bskor dgos te/ g.yas g.yon gang nas 'dzag pa'i phyogs de nyid g.yab bo// snabs dang 'dres na snabs sngo bsangs tshwa mi bro ba 'byung*/ rtags gzhan gong dang 'dra/ de la bum can gyi ngang nas sna bkag ste sna'i rlung (279)rngubs pa de kas sel/ rna pags dang lhan cig 'byung ba yang rtags gzhan 'dra ba las/ rna ba'i gting za bar 'ong*/ de la'ang rlung sbyor bshad ma thag pa de khas phan cing rna pags de zos na'ang phan par bshad do// de dag ni gegs sel spyi khog bshad pa'i sde tshan te dang po'o// gzhan yang rlung stobs 'phel te lus lji/ nyams shed chung*/ chags pa srab par 'gyur te/ de la g.yas kyi rlung 'gro 'ong gi bzlas pa dang*/ g.yas nas 'bud rngub kyi bum can byas pas sel/ de bzhin du chu rlung 'phel te grang shul dang khong 'dar byed/ ngag smra brjod dka' bar gyur na dri chu'i rtsa'i lam nas rdor bzlas sogs bya/ me rlung 'phel te lus rngul/ drod skye mig mi gsal bar song na sna g.yon nas bya/

rlung gi rlung 'phel te lus yang shes pa 'phyo/ sdod mi tshugs/ sna 'gag pa'am dri mi tshor na bshad pa'i rtsa lam la dmigs nas rdor bzlas sogs bya/ mkha' khams 'phel te g.yang sa skye/ rig pa skyo/ stong nyams 'ba' zhig 'char/ rna ba 'on pa la sogs par gyur na 'og sgo gnyis 'byed 'dzum yang yang bya/ khu ba'i lam la dmigs nas rdor bzlas sogs bya/ ye shes kyi khams 'phel nas chags pa drag po skye/ 'dzag gegs 'byung*/ smyo ba ltar gyur na rlung mnyam rgyur btang*/ dbu ma la dmigs nas rdor bzlas bum can sogs bya'o// yang mnyam gnas la sogs pa'i rlung skyon kyang 'chos dgos te/ mnyam gnas rgyas pas mang du zos (280)kyang bkres shing stobs chung*/ ngal zhing dub na g.yas kyi me rlung la dmigs nas bum can dang rdor bzlas byas pas sel/ mnyam gnas stobs nyams na zas mi 'ju/ dmu chu dang skran sogs su 'gyur bas g.yon gyis rlung la dmigs/ srog rlung 'phel na drod nyams/ rlung sems rgod/ smyo 'bog tu 'gyur/ dri chu'i lam gyi rlung la dmigs/ des stobs nyams na lus stobs 'tshor/ dran pa nyams brgyal ba la sogs par 'gyur te bshad pa'i rtsa'i rlung la dmigs/ gyen rgyu 'phel na dbugs lhag par rgod/ bza' btung la sred/ mang du smra/ g.yon gyi chu rlung la dmigs/ de stobs nyams na dbugs 'gro 'ang dka'/ bza' btung gi ro mi tshor/ g.yal dang skyigs bu 'byung*/ g.yon pa'i rlung gi rlung la dmigs pa'am/ dri chu'i lam la dmigs/ thur sel 'phel na bshang gci khu ba rlung ste 'og gi rgyun lam bzhi 'dzag pa dang lus 'dar pa sogs su 'gyur/ de la g.yon gyis rlung dam bshang ba'i rlung la dmigs/ de stobs nyams na rtsa chu bsdoms/ res mi thon/ pho ba 'ur sgra 'byung*/ g.yon gyi me rlung ngam sna g.yas kyi rlung la dmigs/ khyab byed 'phel na tshigs rnams skrang*/ 'gro 'dug dka' pags pa dang ba spu'i khur bu rnams tsha zhing gzer/

g.yon gyi rlung gi mtha' 'am dud can ma la dmigs/ de stobs nyams na lus skrang*/ pags pa 'gog /kha spu byi/ za phrug la sogs par 'gyur/ de la dbu ma la dmigs shing mnyam rgyu'i steng nas rdor bzlas dang bum can byas pas sel/ rlung (281)rengs bcos pa ni/ srog rlung snying khar gzer na stod 'tshangs dang snying gzer 'ong*/ rengs na snying rlung du 'gro bas lus chur bcug ste gang na sa de chu'i rba la gtad/ de rjes bsku mnye bya/ nor bu sems bzung bas sel/ gyen rgyu zin na pho ba'o// mkhal sked na/ gzer zhing skyug /rengs na po gzer dang*/ dmu chur 'gro/ de la chang gi kha phru gdab/ na sar dugs bya/ skyigs bu 'don/ shes pa mgrin par gtod/ thur sel zin na dbyi mig na/ ro smad bshal/ dri chen ha cang bska ba dang sla bar 'gyur/ rengs na smad 'khyal du 'gro bas bshang gci'i lam gyi bar du drag tu mnye zhing dugs bya/ 'og sgo'i rlung steng du drag tu drangs/ shes pa tshangs bug tu gtod/ gyen rgyu zin na mgrin pa skrang*/ rtse'u chung dang rtse mgo na/ rengs na lkog 'bras su 'gro bas/ rlung thur du mnan cing mgrin pa skor/ rlung sna nas 'bud pa dang drag tu 'don/ khyab byed zin na mgo bo sogs lus khol bur na/ rengs na sgur por 'gro bas 'chongs rgyug dang bsku mnye bya/ mig tu rgyu ba'i rlung rengs na rab rim dang skam tshag la sogs par 'gyur/ chu grang dang*/ gur gum la sogs pa'i bsil sman gdab/ mthil bzhi dang po la gong la khrus dang byug pa bya/ rna ba la mi na ba'i ngos bkab nas/ na ba ngos nas rlung drag tu drangs/ kha sna nas 'bud/ sna la yang sna bug bkag nas de bzhin du bya/ lce la yang kha btsum/ lce sgril ba dang gcu ba mang du byas nas/ lce brkyang zhing kha nas rlung mang du (282)'don/ bags pa sogs lus spyi dang bye brag la rlung drag tu rngubs/ rkang pa'i sor mo bsdus la bro 'khrab/

lag pa'i sor mo bskum la drag tu sprugs pas sel/ lus kyi cha shas so so dang rlung bcu'i gnas gang la yang rung ste/ so so'i 'khrul 'khor byas pas mchog tu phan par 'gyur zhing*/ gang na sar gtad nas bum pa can 'bugs pa bzhin bzung ba dang*/ gang na sa de nyid stong par bsgom pa dang*/ gang na sar bu gdod cing*/ ha zhes klung drag tu bus pas bu ga nas rgyangs rgyangs thon par bsgom pas kyang phal cher sel ba yin no// yang srog rtsol bsgom pas thur rlung gyen du log nas stod 'tshangs sogs byung na/ lus gnad khu tshur brla bzhag dang*/ rkang sor bskums/ smad kyi nya bzhi bsgrim/ thur rlung drag tu bskum pas kyang sel/ yang nang gi khams 'khrugs pa las/ bad kan rgyas te spyi bo dang dpral ba lci zhing mi theg pa snyams byed/ lus ldi shed chung na dpral ba'i bum can gyi 'dug stangs lta bu'i ngang nas rlung rgyu zhabs su drag tu mnan pas sel/ 'dis ni 'khru nad dang*/ chu srib la'ang phan mkhris pa skyes te kha skoms shing kha bar 'gyur/ skom dang che na snying ga dang mgrin pa'i bum can bsgom/ 'dis rgyab kyi zug rngu yang 'jom/ 'dus pa'i nad la brten pa'i lus phrum gzer 'byung na/ lus gnad sor sdud dang 'dra ba las thog mar steng rlung mnan/ de nas thur sel 'then pa'i kha sbyor gyis sel/ rim gyi tsha ba'i khyad par 'ga' zhig la mun khang du mnyam pa'i stabs kyis 'dug /sked pa sogs lus drang por (283)bsrangs/ mtheb mdzub kyis sna'i rtsa ba bsdams/ kha sbyor gong bzhin bzung bas sa la 'gyel bar ma gyur gyi bar du bsgom pas sel/ dmu chu dang skran dang gzhang 'brum dang glo nad dang skyigs bu dang dug dang mgo nad dang mig nad rnams kyang bum pa can gyi sbyor ba zla gcig bsgom pas sel bar bshad cing*/ ma zhu ba la gan rkyal du 'dug lte ba'i bum can bzung lag pa g.yon pas lte ba'i pags pa bsdus te mgo dang rkang pa gyen du 'degs pas ldang ba lta bu'i tshul yang yang byed pas sel lo// gzhan yang rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa'i nad kun la so so'i nad kun la so so'i nad bskyed pa'i rtsa 'khor rnams su bum can bsgom zhing nad gzhi dang bstun pa'i kha zas dang spyod lam ma 'khrugs par byas pas sel te/

de yang 'dus pa'i nad ni gsang gnas kyi bar skor 'dab ma bcu dang nang skor 'dab ma drug la brten pa yin pas/ gsang ba'i bum can bsgom pas sel zhing*/ gsang ba'i bum can spyi 'gro des ma sel na dmigs pa rtsa 'khor de gnyis la gtad/ gsang ba'i bum can gyi ngang nas mtha' nas bskor zhing dbus su bsdigs pa mang du byas la/ mthar kha sna gnyis nas rlung ro drag tu 'don pas sel/ de bzhin du gzhan rnams la'ang rigs 'gre ste/ rtsa bzang ba'i rigs dang*/ nad stobs chung ba rnams so so'i bum can dkyus ma de khas sel zhing*/ rtsa ngan pa dang nad stobs chen gyi rigs la des ma sel na rno khyad re gdags pas sel ba yin te/ bad kan skya bor grags pa ni srog rlung gi skyon yin pas steng (284)rlung drag tu rngubs nas lte 'og tu yang yang mnan/ dpral ba'i bum can bsgom pas sel bar 'gyur/ rlung dang grang ba ni thur sel gyi skyon yin pas thur sel drag tu bskums te bde ba skyes skyes su bzung ba lan mang du bya/ bshang sgo rting pas bkag ste gnas pa dang*/ lus kyi smad du drod bskyed pa'i spyod lam byas pas sel/ tsha ba thams cad gyen rgyu dang mnyam gnas kyi skyon yin pas stobs chung na steng 'og gi rlung cung zad re bzung zhing phyi la drag tu 'bud cing*/ 'bud dus rlung zhabs bar rlung cung zad re ma bzung na grang bar thal nyen yod/ stobs che na shid sgra dang bcas te kha nas rlung grang mor rngubs te bzung*/ gtong pa'i skabs su so bsgrigs te seng sgra dang bcas te yun bsring la bus pas sel/ 'dus pa ni khyab byed kyi skyon yin pas/ nad gsum ka'i rlung sbyor re mos su byas pas sel bar 'gyur ro// de bzhin du rlung gi nad ni lte ba'i phyi skor drug cu rtsa bzhi dang*/ gsang gnas kyi phyi skor bcu drug gi nus pa yin pas skyil krung lag gnyis pus mo la bkab pa'am/

tsog bu lag gnyis pus 'khyud kyi tshul bya/ rlung ro bsal/ steng rlung rang babs la 'og rlung bus nas steng du drag tu 'then/ gsang ba nas lte ba'i bar du rgya mtsho bskyod pa'i tshul gyis g.yas g.yon res mos su bskor/ shugs zad pa na thur sel dal bus glod la bzhag /kha dang sna nas rlung drag tu 'bud cing lte ba dang gsang ba'i bum can ci rigs pa bsgom mo// 'dis ni stod 'tshangs dang gzer ba sogs (285)rlung nad thams cad sel/ lus gnad de nyid dang 'dra ba las/ rlung ro bus/ sna nas drag tu rngubs/ lte bar thub tshud du mnan/ thur sel rang babs su bzhag pa lan kha yar byas/ dpral bar dang gtsug tor gyi bum can bzung zhing smin mtshams yan chad kyi mgo bo'i pags pa bskyod cing bsrubs/ mgo sgyed rgu yang yang bya/ mthar rdo rje bsdams pas pho bar brdeg 'dis bad kan gyi nad rnams sel bar 'gyur zhing*/ khyad par bad rlung mgo 'khor sogs la bsngags so// de yang gtsug tor gyi rtsa 'dab bzhi dang*/ dpral ba'i bcu drug bad kan skya bo 'phel zad byed pa'i rtsa yin pa'i gnad kyis so// lus gnad de dang mtshungs pa las/ bdud rtsi lce sbyor gyi man ngag bzhin du rlung grang mo rngubs la bzung*/ mgrin pa skor zhing ro stod gcu/ de rjes 'og rlung rang babs su glod nas steng rlung drag tu btang*/ de ltar yang yang byas pas tsha mkhris sel bar 'gyur la/ grang mkhris la ni rlung sna nas rngubs pas sel/ de yang mgrin pa'i rtsa 'dab so gnyis dang snying ga'i brgyad rnams mkhris pa 'phel zad byed pa po yin pa'i gnad kyis so// gzhan yang ma ning gi bum can cung zad brtan par byas nas/ stod smad gzhan la tho ma song bar bum can nyid lte 'og tu drag tu bskor bas skran dang dmu chu bad kan mkhris pa sogs phal cher sel bar 'gyur/ yang skran ma zhu ba la rgyab rten la cung zad gan kyal du 'dug lag pa g.yon pa'i rdo rje bsdoms pa'i khu tshur kha sbyor gyis pho ba bzung zhing (286)skor pa bum can dang bcas pas sel bar 'gyur ro// de ltar na 'byung ba lnga'i rlung gi gegs sel dang*/

srog la sogs pa rlung lnga'i gegs sel dang*/ rlung rengs bcu bcos pa dang*/ 'khor lo drug la brten pa'i gegs sel te/ de dag gi srog rtsol nyid kyi sgo nas gegs bsal ba'i sde tshan te gnyis pa'o// gzhan yang sman gyi sbyor bas bsal ba la/ spyir lan tshwa dang skyur ba'i sman gyis rlung dang*/ mngar ba dang bska bas mkhris pa dang*/ kha ba dang tsha bas bad kan yang zhes pa spyir btang yin la/ ro nus zhu rjes kyi rnam pa'i dbye ba mtha' yas pa yod pas mtha' gcig tu ma nges la/ khyad par grogs dang cho ga'i sbyor ba sna tshogs las nus pa tha dad pas du mar 'gyur ro// skabs 'dir kun spangs kyi sman sbyor rgyud las gsungs pa ni/ ra'i 'o ma tsha ba gsum dang bcas pas bad kan dang*/ ma he'i 'o ma ka ra dang bcas pas mkhris pa dang*/ rnga mo'i 'o ma rgya tshwa dang bcas pas rlung 'joms shing*/ ba'i 'o ma nyes pa gsum car 'jom byed de/ tsha ba gsum dang bcas pas bad kan/ ka ra dang bcas pas mkhris pa/ rgya mtsho'i tshwa dang bcas pas rlung sel/ sngar gyi sman de rnams dang bcas pa ba'i mar dang bcas te sman mar du sbyar ba spel gyin btang bas ldan 'dus sel la/ 'o ma gsar pa rtag par ma 'byor na de dag gis bsdus pa'i tshegs ma la yang sbyar bar bshad do// dza ti'i 'dab ma'am 'bras bu la rang las brgyad 'gyur gyis mang ba'i chu la bskol te bzhi cha tsam lus pa (287)de'am/ mi bskyod pa cung zad dro ba yun ring du khar bzung bas kha nad dang*/ zug med pa'i so srin sel/ kaṇ+ḍa ka ri'i 'bras bu'i du ba so la bdugs pas kyang zug dang bcas pa'i so srin la phan/ til mar dang ra gcin mnyam du bskol nas bzhi cha tsam lus pa la tsha ba gsum til mar gyi bzhi cha btab rna bar blugs pas rna ba'i nad 'joms shing de bzhin du dri chu dron mo blug pas kyang ngo*// ba mar brgyad 'gyur ba'i 'o ma lhan cig bskol mar khu tsam lus pa na/ nā ga ge sar dang gur gum bsres pa mar gyi gzhi cha'i tshad tsam sbyar nas snar blug pas sna nad sel/

ban+dha ka rko ṭi dang shog shing dang*/ tig ti'i phye ma bong bu'i chu la sbyar ba byugs pas 'bras dang*/ sha ro dang*/ skrangs 'bur la phan/ ban+dha ka rko ṭi ni mkhan pa'i 'bru med pa yin zer ba dang*/ ba sha ka nag po yin par 'dod pa gnyis yod pa phyi ma 'thad do// snga ma yang tshab ma rung bar 'dod cing myong bas grub pa yin na mi 'gal lo// nyi ma'i shing gi 'dab mas bslan pas kyang de ltar 'gyur bar gsungs la/ 'di bod kyi nyi shing ba yin zer ba mi 'thad cing*/ tshab ma lcam pa'i 'dab ma brdungs bas rung bar bzhed do// lan tshwa'i rigs rnyed kyi thum bu mar rnying zhu bar bcug nas dugs byas pas kyang 'bras sogs 'phel ba 'joms shing*/ tho rangs dri chu grang mo snas rngubs nas rlung 'bud pa'am/ chu gang sna nas rngubs pas mgo nad zhi bar byed cing*/ dri chu grang mo mig tu blugs pas mig rim (288)la phan/ tho rangs kha bkrus pa'i so la srin lag gis brdar te mig la byugs pa dang*/ zla 'od kyis phog pa'i chu grang tho rangs blangs nas mig la phyar te blugs pas kyang mig khrag tu song ba sogs la phan no// tshwa ba gsum dri chu la sbyar ba'i khu ba snar blugs pas 'byung pos zin pa dang*/ dug sbrul dang*/ khyi smyon sogs g.yo ba'i dug rnams sel bar 'gyur/ srog rtsol dang bcas te snying khar pad zla'i gdan la sna tshogs yum dkar mo mchog sbyin dang*/ pad dkar 'dzin pa rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa bsgoms nas/ oṃ pheṃ bi shwa mā ta badz+ra kaṇ+ḍa kaṃ/ nā ga ya nā sha ya/ ma ma shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes ci nus su bzlas te/ gnas drug tu sngags chus byugs pas 'brum nag sogs bsrung zhing*/ gzhan la bsrung na/ ma ma zhes pa'i gnas su sgrub bya'i ming bcug nas bzla/ nad gdon gzhan bsrung na/ badz+ra kaṇ+ḍa kaṃ gyi gnas su nad gdon de dang de'i ming bcug pas sel/ 'brum nad byung ba na/ skya nad kyi dus su/

sran chung dang*/ ru rāk+ṣa'i 'bru btags pas chu bskol ba la sbyar te/ sngags brgya rtsa sogs btab nas 'thung zhing*/ nyin zhag gsum la sogs tsha ba cung zad zhi zhing*/ 'brum bu phyir thon pa na 'brum bu'i nad kyis shi bi'i mi thod dri chu grang mo la brdar te/ khor du btong bas sel bar 'gyur/ 'dir bu la sogs pa tshad pa'i nad kyis zin pa la/ skyu ru ra/ 'u su/ da li dkar lo rnams cha mnyam pa nyi ma'i 'od kyis reg pa'i chu brgyad 'gyur la bskor ba/ (289)bzhi cha lus pa'i khu ba de'i bzhi cha'i ka ra dang bsres te/ tho rang zhag gsum la sogs par zos pas/ tshad pa las grol zhing*/ rim gyis btang ba la sman de rnams kyi steng du 'dzim pa dang de gsum 'gyur a ru ra bsres pas sel bar 'gyur la/ 'dzim pa'i tshad ni nad kyi tshod dang sbyar ro// 'byor ldan gyi sman dngul chu'i sbyor ba mang du gsungs kyang*/ bod yul 'dir deng sang rgyud don ltar lag len la khel ba dka' bar snang la/ sman gyi khyad par rnams kyang 'byor ba dka'o// de ltar na bdud rtsi lnga'i bcud len dang*/ gser gyi gong bu'i bcud len sogs rnam gzhag rags pa ni rgyud 'grel nyid na gsal lo// de dag gi skabs nas bshad pa'i bcud len mdor bsdus gnyis ni 'di yin te/ gzhon nu ma'i rdul zla ba mar ngo la bas pa dang*/ bhṛṅga rā dza'i khu ba rlung mnyam rgyu'i dus su sna nas rngubs te bum pa can bzung na rgas pa sel zhing lus kyi srin bu med par 'gyur ro// de la bhṛṅga rā dza ni/ bod yul du dod thub ra mo sha yin zhes skabs 'di dang gzhan du bod rnams phal cher gsung pa/ mngon shes dang ldan pas dod thub kyi sman yin par gzigs na ni ngo mtshar che la/ gzhan du na sman gyi rnam pa dang*/ ro nus zhu rjes ye mi 'dra bas mi 'thad par mngon/ bhṛṅga rā dza ni saṃ skṛ ta'i skad yin la/ 'phral skad du bhaṅga ra zer zhing*/

mon yul phan chad kyi rgya bal kun tu skye la/ de la dkar nag gnyis las bcud len phal cher la/ nag po sbyor gyin snang bas 'dir yang nag po yin no// (290)rgya bal kun tu skye pas btsal na rnyed sla'o// yang sha lnga po rul sum med cing chu ser bton nas skam pa'i phye ma sbrang rtsi'am sbrang chang dang sbyar nas lo gcig zos pas kyang rgas pa dang*/ nad mtha' dag sel la/ de bzhin du me tog dang byang chub kyi sems bsres pas kyang ngo*// zhes bshad do// 'di dag ni kun spangs kyi rdzas sbyor la brten nas gegs bsal ba ste sde tshan gsum pa'o// yang spyi khyab tu log gnon gyi man ngag kyang bstan par bya ste/ tsha ba shas che na spyi bo'i ha las bdud rtsi ga bur gyi chu lta bu babs pas/ lus gang ba dang*/ grang shas che na lte ba'i ho las me 'bar bas gang ba dang*/ lus ljin gsang gnas su rlung gi dkyil 'khor yaṃ gyis mtshan pas lus yer yer du 'degs pa dang*/ rlung 'gags pa'i rigs la bshad lam nas mthon 'gro bar bsam pa dang*/ rlung 'khyims pa la spyi gtsug nas mthon par bsam pa dang*/ khol bur gzer ba la gang na sar sa'i dkyil 'khor gyis mnan par bsgoms pas sel lo// log gnon drug po de ni 'gro ba'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyi man ngag yin no// yang log gnon lnga ste/ stod 'tshangs dang pho ba spos pa sogs lus gang nas nan/ 'khor lo ltar bskor ba bya ste/ bum can bzung*/ lte bar 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa/ g.yas g.yon du res mos kyi 'khor bar bsams la lte ba bskor mthar je che je che la nam mkha'i mthar klas par bsam/ lus dmigs kyi nan/ gru gu ltar 'gril ba bsgom ste/ gang na sar bu ga hur gyis (291)byung*/ rlung bzung nas gtong ba'i dus su/ bu ga nas phar rlung ro nag po rta rnga lta bur nar gyis thon/ phyi rol du gru gu ltar 'gril nas nang du mi bzlog par bsam/ rim gyis de je sbom du btang*/

lus phal cher khyab par na bu ga mang po'i sbyor ba bya ste/ lus lcags tshags lta bur bsam/ rlung ro drag tu gdon/ bu ga thams cad nas rlung 'tshub kyi rnam pa phyur phyur 'gro bar bsam/ lus stod smad phyed mar na ba sogs byung na/ 'khor lo med pa zhes bya ba bsgom ste/ gang nas de sbubs stong je yangs je yangs la sogs ste/ nam mkha' dang 'dres par bsam/ rlung gis shes pa 'phro zhing yer pa dang*/ mchongs rgyug byed pa sogs byung na rab tu dma' ba'i sbyor ba zhes bya ba la bslab ste/ nyal sa yangs pa dong lta bur bya/ dmigs pa rang lus sa 'og tu thim pa'am/ chu dron mo'i nang du bying shing lus zhu ba'am/ mar nag gi mtsho nang du lus bcug par bsgom pas sel/ log gnon lnga po 'di ni bsam mi khyab kyi gdams ngag sogs na yang snang ngo*// spyir gegs sel gyi gdams ngag ni gcig tu ma nges pa med de/ lam gyi cha lag tsam yin pa'i phyir dang*/ gegs mi 'byung ba yang mang zhing*/ phan tshun bsre slad du 'gyur ba'i nyes pa 'ga' yang mi bskyed pas na/ gdams ngag gzhan las 'byung ba rnams kyang 'dir blangs pas chog la/ de yang man ngag khungs ma lag len dang 'brel ba zhig blangs dgos kyi/ lag len gyi rgyun med na gnad longs ba dka' zhing*/ (292)man ngag bsdus pa las 'byung ba rnams kyi lag len yod kyang gegs mi sel ba'am/ phyogs gcig gi gegs sel kyang gegs gzhan skye ba sogs 'byung bas/ lag len khungs ldan btsal bar byas la/ spyir rtsa'i gegs sel 'khrul 'khor/ rlung gi gegs sel rlung sbyor/ thig le'i gegs sel de gnyis 'dzom pa'i bzhu btul/ sems kyi gegs la dmigs pa'i gnad sna tshogs su 'pho ba rnams kyis sel ba yin no// skabs de dag thams cad du/ ye shes phebs pa'i nyams dang*/ sgom log gi gegs dang*/ sgom skyon ma yin pa'i 'byung ba lus 'khrugs kyi nang rnams ma nor ba gal che/ ye shes phebs pa'i nyams la/

ha 'don dang dbyug bcos dang sman dang*/ me gtar la sogs pa gang yang mi bya ste/ nyams ngo sprad de nyams byung rgyal du bskyangs pas gegs med cing*/ yon tan gong du 'gyur/ bcos gzhan de rnams byas na/ sgom log tu 'gyur zhing gegs chen bod gdod skye ba mang zhing*/ nyams bzang po yal zhing yon tan skye 'phro 'chad pa yin no// sgom skyon tsam yin na/ dmigs pa rlung sbyor 'khrul 'khor sogs kyis sel dgos shing*/ sman gtor ba yang rung la/ me gtar dbyug bcos sogs ni phal cher la mi legs so// sgom skyon ma yin par/ nad gzhi tsam gyis khams ma snyoms pa yin na/ nang gi rnal 'byor dang sman spyad me gtar la sogs pa gang gis bcos kyang rung bar shes par bya'o// de dag ni log gnon gegs sel gyi sde tshan te bzhi pa'o// yang rnal 'byor (293)yan lag drug pa'i gegs sel gyi man ngag sman dpyad dang shas cher 'brel ba lugs gzhan yang brjod par bya ste/ 'di la gnyis te/ rten lus las byung ba'i gegs dang*/ brten pa sems las byung ba'i gegs so// dang po la rtsa rlung thig le gsum las/ rtsa ni rang bzhin gyis bzang ba dang*/ ngan pa gnyis yod kyang rlung sems kyi gnas tshul yin pas lus dal ba dang*/ skabs su khrus dang*/ bsku mnye dang*/ lus kyi gnad bcun pa dang*/ lus mi 'grim pa kho nas chog go /'on kyang sgom pa'i rkyen rnams/ khur so'am/ brdabs pa la sogs pas mi bde ba dang*/ rtsa phran chad pa lta bu thams cad la lus dal bar bya ste/ mi bskyod pa'am/ yang na 'om bu dang*/ bal lu dang*/ shug pa dang*/ mtshe dang*/ mkhan pa btsos pa'i chus bkrus la/ skabs su bsku byug bya ste/ des bde bar 'gyur ro// rtsa chad pa dang rma byung na dmigs pa ni khams byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar 'thab pa la sems gtad la skabs su mi bskyod pas bkru'o// sngo bre gam thang du bya ba'am/ sprang dang sbyar la bza'/

'di ni chad pa dang*/ mgo lus kyi rtsa skyon dang mtshon gyi rma thams cad la phan pa yin no// rtsa 'chus pa lta bu la ni/ thog ma ji ltar bsdad pa'i lus gnad byas la/ de nas khang kyi rlung 'jam por bzung la/ lus g.yas dang g.yon du gcu zhing lag mthil gyis byug /rtsa'i nad kyi gegs thams cad la 'di rnams kyis phan no// gnyis pa rlung (294)gi gegs la gsum du 'dus ste/ rtsa ba'i rlung lnga dang yan lag gi rlung lnga dang*/ khyad par gyi rlung rengs lnga'o// mkhris pa dang*/ bad kan gnyis thig le'i snyigs ma yin yang*/ rlung gis ma dkrugs na nad mi byed pas/ mi mnyam mkhris pa dang bsdongs nas tshad pa'i nad thams cad bskyed pas de ni rgyu yin te/ rkyen dus dang gdon dang*/ zas dang spyod lam bzhis byed la/ gnas pa'i sa mchin mkhris la brten nas nad du byed pa ni/ khrag sha tshil rus rkang khu ba'i gnas su song nas/ don snod la gnad du 'gro ba yin/ nad rigs mang yang skabs 'dir khrag 'phel ba dang*/ mkhris pa 'phel ba gnyis las/ rtags ni kha kha zhing*/ lce gzhung ser/ lus drod che gnyid che/ drod bcud gnod/ nyi mas dron na/ chu dmar ser la spris ma 'thug /rnyog ma che/ rtsa drag tu 'phar zhing grims/ khyad par du nyin gung mtshan gung la mi bde ba yin/ de bsal ba ni/ kha zas mi za/ lus rtsog bu'am/ skyil krung gang bde bya/ rlung kha nas sid sgras rngubs la/ pho bar dgang*/ sna nas hūm̐ gis drag tu dbyung*/ re mos kyi thun du bcad la bya/ dmigs pa ni pho bar me mnyam gnas pa'i sar/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsil ba dang 'od dang bcas pa yar 'gro mar 'gro la sems gtad/ des kyang mi phan pa'i nad stobs che na/ mi bskyod pa grang mo la/ a ru ra/ gla rtsi/ tsan dan/ ga bur bzhi gang rnyed btab la btung*/ rlung myur du skye ru 'ong bas (295)brtags shing byed pa gal che'o// khyad par du gnyan dang tshad gzer drag po byung na/

gong gi dmigs pa bya/ rlung mi bzung*/ dri chu/ gla rtsi/ thar nu/ bong nga*/ ming can/ ru rta/ li shi gang 'dzom btags la cha mnyam par byas la btang*/ gong gi sman de rnams ma rnyed kyang*/ chu grang dang mi bskyod pa kho nas phan par bshad do// nad kyi rtse chag nas btung du mi btub/ grang bar 'gro 'ong bas so// gnyis pa bad kan la skya ser smug po gsum yod kyang*/ skya bo pho stod na gnas/ ser po mkhris pa dang bsdongs pa yin/ smug po ni lus kyi khrag pho bar babs pa yin/ spyir brten pa ni klad pa yin/ rtags ni lus lci/ dang kha mi bde/ bsnabs dang*/ chu skyur dang*/ ser po dang*/ khrag rul skyug /chu dkar la rnyog /smug po la smug la rnyog /dri chen sol ba 'dra ba'am/ khrag dang ser bor 'ong*/ zas bcud chen gnod/ rtsa dal zhing bying ba yin/ khyad par du dpyid dang*/ srod dang*/ snga gro dang*/ de bcos pa ni/ rlung steng 'og kha sbyar la bzung*/ kha zas ran par bza'/ skabs su sna dang kha nas dbyung*/ sked pa dang*/ rkang pa dang*/ lag pa rnams mi bde na sked skor dang sprug pa bya/ sman byed na/ skyi bo'i snams su skyug pa la/ se 'bru/ sug smel/ shing tshwa/ pi pi ling btang*/ 'gril pa lta bu byung na cong zhi dang*/ tshwa bsregs pa bsnan la btang*/ ser po la gong (296)gi se 'bru bzhi pa la/ a ru ra dang brag zhun bsnan la btang*/ pho ba lag mthil gyis mnye/ de rnams kyis ma phan na/ pho stong du ber ka brdeg go /smug po la ni/ cong zhi/ brag zhun/ 'u su/ sga skya/ a ru ra/ gur gum/ pri yang ku rnams sbyar la za/ des kyang 'gril zhing ma phan na/ mi bskyod pa la a ru ra/ dong ga /tshwa la bsregs pa btab cing 'thungs pas sbyongs yong*/ sbyongs rjes/ se 'bru bzhi pa dang gong ma rnams za/ ber ka dang 'khrul 'khor drag po rnams mi bya'o// byas na yang khrag pho bar babs nas nar 'ong*/ khyad par du cong zhi khrol bur zos nas lus sbyongs sngags so// gsum pa rlung gi nad la/

spyir rtsa ba dang yan lag gi rlung thams cad kyi gegs sel ba dang*/ bye brag so sor bsal ba'o// dang po lus thams cad dri ba dang*/ 'khyoms pa dang 'phyo zhing gnyid med pa dang*/ gzir gzug dang*/ chu sngo zhing sbu ba che/ rtsa dal myur gang yin yang stong zhing*/ dgongs kha dang tho rangs na ba ni rtags yin no// gegs sel ni lus la bsku byug bya/ rkang pa skyil krung lag pa mnyam bzhag bya/ mig thur la gtad/ dmigs pa lte 'og tu sa'i dkyil 'khor ram/ gser gyi rdo rje shin tu lci ba zhig pa sgom la 'og sgo drag tu bsdom zug gi dmigs la rdo'am/ gyo dum tsha mos bdug /zas drod bcud bsten no// rlung gi nad phal che ba des sel bar 'gyur ro// bye brag tu sel ba la rtsa ba'i rlung lnga srog 'dzin la ni/ (297)'khrugs pa dang*/ rengs pa dang*/ stod ste gnas 'khyams pa gsum ste/ dang po ni 'khrugs pa'i rkyen ni sgom pa dang*/ slob gnyer drag po dang*/ mya ngan dang*/ sems las drag pos byed la/ ngo bo ni srog rtsa'i rlung 'khrugs pa yin/ rtags ni mchin srog dang sgal gzhung na/ sems mi bde/ kha nas shugs ring 'don/ snying 'phar zhing*/ phyi rol gyi skad dang*/ rdog sgra snying gi nang du grags pa snyam byed/ de la bcos pa ni/ lus thams cad sbang ma'am/ mkhan pa'i chu dang mi bskyod pas bkrus la bsku byug bya/ dmigs pa ni/ lus stong sang nge bal/ nang du zla ba'i 'od shar ba ltar dkar song nge bar bsam/ lus skyil krung bcas la pus mo gnyis la lag pas 'jus te lus bsrang*/ mgrin par dgye bor rgyab tu 'then la kha nas ha zhes drag la ring bar brjod la rlung dbyung zi thom byung ba dang bzhag /des gyen du 'tshangs byung na/ 'bebs pa'i 'khrul 'khor 'ga' bya/ rjes la bsku byug bya/ de ltar thun du bcad la bya/ dus gcig la mang grags na mi bzang*/ rim gyis je mang du bya'o// srog 'dzin rengs pa ni/

srog rtsa'i nang du shing bcug pa 'dra/ rtags gzhan sngar dang phyogs mthun/ de bsal pa ni/ lus tsog pur byas nas/ rlung sna nas hūm̐ gis dal bus dbyung*/ yang skyil krung byas te sa la brdab/ de gnyis res mos bya/ dmigs pa lte bar thig le dkar dmar 'thab pa la sems gtad/ des sel lo// srog (298)rlung stengs to gnas 'khyams na/ rtags snga ma rnams kyi thog tu shes pa dang*/ rlung nang du bsdud cing brgyal ba lta bu 'byung*/ de la lus sbyongs dang*/ rlung rtsol drag po mi bya bar klod la/ rig pa rang sor bzhag /steng du rlung sems 'gro ba snyam byed na/ 'og tu shes pa gtad/ bying ba snyam byed na/ mgrin pa'am dpral bar gtad/ nang du 'thum pa snyam byed na kha sna gnyis ka nas dbyung ngo*// sman byed na/ a ga ru nag po/ go snyod/ snying zho sha*/drod sman hril 'jong gnyis ka /ru rta/ spos dkar/ dzā ti de rnams gang 'tshogs btang*/ rlung stobs shin tu che na/ sha chen nam/ shing khun/ sgog skya btang*/ rlung skye ba'i spyod lam mi bya'o// gnyis pa gyen rgyu la gsum ste/ thur sel la bsdongs te stod du 'tshangs pa dang*/ 'khrugs pa dang*/ stor ba'o// dang po ni/ sgom nyes pa dang*/ nyal nyes pa dang*/ lha stangs steng du grags pas byung ba yin/ rtags ni dang po pho ba nas yar phus btab pa bzhin 'ong zhing*/ mgrin pa man chad rkyal pa phus btab pa'am// khang chung dud pas 'tshub pa bzhin 'ong zhing gzer/ skad mi thon/ 'og sgo sdud mi shes/ de bcos pa ni/ lus tsog bu'am/ yang na skyil krung bya/ rang gi lag pa gnyis kyi mkha' la lus bteg la brdab/ rang gis mi nus na/ stan gyi stebs su bsdad la/ mi gnyis kyis sor bzhi tsam bteg la brdab/ lan gsum bzhi tsam nas sa la bzhag la tshigs gzhung khu tshur gyis brdung*/ rlung (299)gi gnad ni/ 'og sgo drag tu bsdam/ steng ye mi bzung*/ dmigs pa ni lus 'degs dus su/

rlung thams cad 'og sgo nas thon nas dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi la thim par bsgom mo// 'khrugs pa ni/ rtags gzhan sngar dang phyogs mthun pa las/ mi nor pa'i rtags ni/ stong du 'tshangs pa dang*/ phur bus btab pa bzhin gzer yang 'og sgo ni sdud shes pa'o// 'di bcos pa ni/ gang gzer sar gru gu'am/ pho rdu khu tshur tsam bcings la/ grogs gcig gis ro stod sang gis btab la sprug /de nas dal bus sa la bzhag ste/ khu tshur gyis brdung ba dang bsku byug bya'o// des ma phan na sngar ltar yang bya'o// 'di gnyis ni/ nad rlung rtsa la rengs pa'i stod rengs kyang yin no// yang 'khrugs pa'i rigs gcig la ske dang lkog ma skrangs shing 'gyur mi shes pa dang*/ kha 'tham pa 'ong ste/ de la ni rlung kha sbyor byas nas mgrin par drag tu bkang la lag pas mnye/ gtong tsa na ha zhes sna nas btang*/ ha yang skabs su brjod/ g.yer ma go snyod tshwa dang gsum mar nag gam mar gang rung la sbyar nas bskol la 'jam tsam gyis byugs la 'phur/ skabs su mi skyod pas bkru'o// stong pa ni rlung gi nus pa zad pa yin te/ stod rnams mi bde rlung bus tsam shed med pa cig 'ong*/ mgo zi ba la sogs pa'i rlung rtags 'ong*/ de bcos pa ni/ bsku byug dang drod dugs bya/ rlung nang du bzung*/ dbyung ba bya mi nyan/ (300)mdor na gyen rgyu'i nus pa skye dgos pa yin/ gong gi gnyis ni gyen rgyu 'phel ba'i skyon yin pas gzhi la dgos pa yin no// gsum pa thur sel la skyon gsum ste/ gyen rgyu dang 'grogs te smad du 'tshangs pa dang*/ 'khrugs pa dang stongs pa'o// dang po ni/ thur du rlung mi thon te/ 'og rgyangs nas rdo ltar 'gro zhing gzer/ rtsa sdud zhag gcig lus na srog gi bar chad du 'gro ste/ de bsal ba ni lus tsog pur byas la/ lag pa gnyis dpung pa la bsnol mar 'jus te/ rlung sna nas hūm̐ zhes dal la ring bar bus te phyir bkag la/

lte ba/ rgal pa la sbyar la yar nus tshad 'then la/ yang rlung rngubs pa dang dus gcig tu lus klod/ dmigs pa ni rlung thams cad smin mtshams su 'dus par bsams te/ lta stangs smin phrag tu gtad/ de ltar mang dus byas pa'i rjes la/ 'phur ba dang bsku byug bya/ des sel lo// 'khrugs pa ni/ gong dang 'dra la khad pa la/ khyad par ni res na res bde/ dri chu ser la sdom/ res bshal/ tsha 'khyug byed/ de bsal ba ni/ lte 'og tu 'bo rdo khu tshur tsam du bcings la/ kha bub tu nyal te rkang pa'i rting pas 'phongs su rdeg cing brkyang bskum res mos kyis bya'o// yang na grogs gcig gis rkang pa gyen du bstan nas khur tha'am sang gis 'degs pa gang bde byas la sprug rjes su rgal tshigs la sogs pa rnams ran par khu tshur gyis brdung ba bsku byug bya'o// stongs pa ni/ thur sel gyi nus pa nyams pa yin pas/ rtsa rgyud rnams nas khog smad lci 'og rlung mi thub pa yin/(301)de ni kha zas drod bcud bsten/ 'og sgo 'then 'phul bya/ bcu drug mdor khu tshul kyis brdung ste des sel bar 'gyur ro// de ltar stod smad gnyis ka la rjes phan dka' na/ gang dmigs yod par ber ka rdeg go /dzā ti/ rgyaṃ tshwa/ drod sman hril 'jongs/ shing khun/ sgog skya gang 'dzom rus khu'am/ chang gis phul la btang bar bya'o// 'di ni pho ba'i mkhris pa 'ju byed stongs pa'i nad yin no// bzhi pa me mnyam la ni gegs gsum ste/ gang ba dang*/ stong pa dang*/ gzer ba'o// dang po ni pho ba'i rlung gis stong sbos byas te/ mi bde zhing*/ 'grangs pa dang*/ ltogs dus mi bde ba yin/ de la rlung kha nas pho bar ming pa bzhin byas te bcug la lag mthil gyis mnye/ de nas sbreg pa bton pas chog go /sman byed na/ se 'bru/ sug smel/ li shi/ pi pi ling*/ tsi tra ga /rgyam tshwa gang 'dzom chu bskol gyis phul la btang ngo*// 'di ni pho ba'i bad kan myags byed dang gnyis bsdongs pa yin pas rlung kha nas ha zhes bton nas/

rjes su ber ka khru gang tsam gyis rtse mo pho khar gtad de bskor ba dang*/ yang na lag pa'i khu tshur pho khar gtad la/ mgo bo thur du bstan nas bya/ skyug ba byung na bde bar 'gyur ro// stong pa la rigs gnyis yod de/ grang bas stongs pa dang*/ tshad pas stongs pa'o// de la grang bas stongs pa ni/ pho bar 'ur sgra sgrog cing*/ sgra bcas su sbyong*/ be snabs dang zas mdog 'khru ba yin/ de (302)la ni gong gi sman nam/ yang na tsha ba gsum po gang rnyed btang zhing*/ skeng skor mang du byas pas sel lo// cha bas stongs pa ni/ khrag gam ser po'am/ chu 'khru yang drod chen po tsha sha ra ra sbyong pa yin/ de la ni kha nas rlung sgra bcas su pho bar bcug la/ pho bar 'phur bsub bya/ 'og sgo mthem 'phul bya/ des kyang ma phan na/ chu grang ngam/ mi bskyod pa grang mo btung la lus sbyongs bya/ rgyam tshwa/ kha ru tshwa/ snya lo/ btsong*/ a ru ra/ brag zhun gang rnyed thad du byas la btung ngo*// 'di ni 'pho ba'i mkhris pa 'ju byed dang bsdongs pa'i nad yin no// tsha grang gnyis ka'i rjes su 'bras thug gam tha rams sam/ ram bu'i thug pas sbyongs bcad do// yang na da trig gi thang btang ngo*// snga ma rnams kyis 'khru ba chad na de tsho btang mi dgos so// gzer ba ni/ pho ba'i dkyil du gzer ba yin te/ de la rlung gis pho ba bkang la/ lag pa gnyis spyi bor bteg cing pho bar brdeg /yang na mnye zhing khu tshur gyis brdung*/ 'di la yang nang du tsha lam lam byed na tshad pa yin/ grang lhang lhang byed na grang ba yin pas/ rlung 'dzin lugs dang sman ni snga ma dang 'dra'o// gsum ka la lto ba gyang ngam shing ngam/ rdo lta bu la bkal la rkang lag re mos kyi g.yab cing ha zhes rlung kha nas bton pas kyang phan/ gzer ba 'di srin la yang long bas srin nad la ni/ a ru ra/ zil tshwa/ rgyam tshwa/ pi pi ling chu bskol gyis phul la btang bas phan/ des kyang mi phan pa'i thub la/

thang khrom gyi 'bras bu bsnan/ cis (303)kyang ma phan nam/ sman ma rnyed na/ srin 'gril sar ber ka brdeg cing*/ tshwa chu blud pas phan no// da ni zhar la ma zhu pa 'chos na/ ma zhu ba gsang pa la ni/ rlung kha nas pho bar bcug cing lus tsog bu bsdad la/ 'og sgo 'then 'phul bya zhing*/ 'khrul 'khor gyis dkrugs pas sbyongs par 'gyur ro// yang kha nas sgro'am/ mdzub mo bcug ste rlung kha nas gyen du drangs la skyug go /sman gyis bcos na/ mar dang zho dar dang 'o ma rnams ma zhu ba la/ chu khur bskor la btung*/ sha ma zhu na sogs pa'i khrung khrung bskol la btung*/ chang ma zhu na sog tshigs bskol la btung*/ tsam pa ma zhu na bul tog bskol la btung*/ chu dang sman ma zhu na rgyam tsha bskol la btung*/ ma zhu ba rnying pa 'gril ba dang*/ skran la pho bar rlung bcug ste lag pa'i sor mos yun ring du mnyes la/ rjes su a ru ra dang rgyam tsha'i thang res mos kyis btang*/ des bde bar 'gyur ro// lnga pa khyab byed la gegs gsum ste/ rengs pa dang 'khrugs pa dang stong pa'o// dang po ni/ drag shul dang rlung gis rkyen gyis rkang lag rnams glo bur du rengs shing 'khum bar 'gyur te/ de la mar rnying pa'am zhun gyis legs par byug la/ rlung gis lus thams cad dal bus bkang la/ phur zhing kha sna gnyis nas hūm̐ dang he yis dbyung*/ drod sman ci rigs btang*/ des 'tsho'o// gnyis pa 'khrugs pa ni/ lus kyi yan lag gi rtsa rgyus rnams na zhing*/ khab gyis gtsags pa 'dra ba 'byung ste/ de la bsku byug bya zhing*/ zas bcud (304)can bsten/ mi bskyod pas bkru/ rlung kha sbyor ran par bzung ngo*// 'khrul 'khor mi chen lugs bya/ yang 'khrugs pa rigs gcig pags pa thams cad rtse zhing chu bur thug thug pa 'byung*/ de la mi bskyod pa'am/ mkhan pa'i chus bkru/ chu grang mo'am mi bskyod pa la spangs pa'i ras kyis bkris la/ rlung kha sbyor nus tshad du bsdom des bde bar 'gyur ro// gsum pa stongs pa ni yan lag gi shed shor nas sgul skyod dka' ba dang*/

tshigs rnams lhod cing mi theg pa yin/ de la rlung bzung nas phur bsrub legs par bya zhing*// khong du dbang po lag pa la sogs pa'i rtsa ba lnga/ sbrang rtsi'am mar dkar dang sbyar la za/ rlung bzung nas rtsed mo dang mchongs rgyug bya/ des skyon las grol lo// da ni gnyis pa yan lag gi rlung rnam pa lnga las/ mig du rgyu ba rengs na/ tsha grang gnyis las/ grang ba la rlung dang bad kan gnyis te/ dang po ni rlung bsgoms pas mig 'bur ba dang mi gsal bar gyur na/ ras la mi bskyod pa grang mo btab la mig dkris te ltag khung du mdud la phyi gan du nyal la/ rkang lag drag tu brkyangs la gcud cing brkyang bskum bya/ rkang pa'i rting pa dang ltag khung ru bsku byug bya zhing*/ dmigs pa ni ltag khung du thig le dkar po'am/ ser po la dmigs pa gtad/ mig tu rlung rengs nas ha re long ba lta bur gyur na/ srin lag gi lag pa'i mthil du drud la mig tu blan/ lag pa'i mthil gyis dal bus phur zhing zas drod bcud bstan no// zas za dus mig la rlangs pas bdug /mig gi (305)'khrul 'khor bya/ bad kan gyi mig skya rib tu gyur na/ snga dro kha ma bshal ba'i so la sen mos drung la mig la blan/ rtag tu du sbrang dang sbyar la bza'/ yang na a ba/ gur gum/ mdung rtse/ go snyod/ dom mkhris/ lcags sprul a ru'i skyo ma lcags sder la byug pa rnams sbrang dang sbyar la lto stong la thun re bza'/ bad kan la gnod pa'i zas mi za'o// tshad pa'i rkyen las byung ba'i mig nad ni/ khrag dang mkhris pa gnyis las/ khrag gi nad kyis mig tshag pa dang*/ sha 'dzer phyung pa dang*/ mkhris pas mig drod che zhing ser ba yong*/ de dag thams cad la mi bskyod pra grang mo byas la mig la byug /des kyang ma phan na/ ltag khung gi mig rtsa la dbyug pa rgyab la khrag dbyung*/ mig gnad sa la yang mi bskyod pa grang mo btab cing khrag skyes na gong ltar bya'o// ling thog dang sha 'dzer byung na/

ling thog gi dkyil na phar rlung thon par bsam la dmigs pa gtad/ oṃ theb long*/ neb long*/ tsha te long*/ sur+ya tsan+d+ra 'di long cig ces bzlas la ltag khung nas gdab/ phug ron gyi dong sgro la sngags la/ ling thog blangs/ gong gi sman yang byug /shin tu bcad dka' na/ mi rus tsa can/ rgya tshwa/ dung bsregs pa'i phye ma btab/ rjes su gur gum byug go /rna ba ru rgyu ba rengs na/ nad rigs mang yang tshad pas 'gram pa dang rlung gnyis las dang po ni/ rna ba nas khrag dang chu ser dang rnag 'bab pa dang drod che ba'o// de rnams la thog mar seng ge rnam grol gyi phyag (306)rgya cung zad bya sprugs la/ de'i 'og tu rlung dbyung ba byas te/ rna ba ru rlung dang rig pa gtad pas des rnag la sogs pa thon no// rnag khrag skams nas 'on na rna ba'i gting du sngo ba dang dmar ba 'byung*/ de la rgya tshwa dang*/ khug chos kyi 'bras bu/ ru rta gsum mi bskyod pa dang sbyar la rna bar blug cing dal bus phye ma/ rjes su ma 'gram par bya'o// rlung gis 'on pa la/ gtum mo'i me la dmigs pa gtad cing rna ba'i mdun du snum byugs la mnye'o// rna ba ru rlung dang rol mo'i sgra byung zhing 'on na/ mgo rus rnying pa bskol ba'i chang du/ shing khun/ dbang po lag pa/ ru rta/ kha ru tshwa/ se 'bru/ sug smel/ pi pi ling*/ mkhal ma zho sha rnams phye ma zhib tu byas la btab ste bskol ba'i rlangs pa la rna ba bdug cing rlang pa yal ba dang*/ khu ba phor chung re btung des rlung 'on la phan no// snar rgyu ba rengs na dbugs dbyung rngub dka' zhing du ba 'tshub pa ltar 'gyur/ he'i sgras rlung mang du dbyung rngub bya/ chu ser ram thor bu lta bus 'gags na/ ru rta dang*/ bca' sga mi bskyod pa dang sbyar la snar rngubs te mnyes la/ drag tu bus rjes su mi bskyod pas kyang bkru/ sna khrag shor na/ lus skyil krung byas la/ lag pa rgyab gzhung du khu tshur mi drag tsam gyis brdung zhing*/

sprug pa dang rdung ba re mos bya'o// shin tu chod dka' ba la/ skra bsregs pa dang*/ de nyid skam pa'i phye ma snar rngub cing*/ smin mtshams dang tshigs pa drug bdun gyi g.yas g.yon du ber ka brdeg /rdo grang mo blan no// (307)rlung gi rkyen gyis sna khrag 'ong ba yang yod pas/ rkang mthil du sgog pa byug go /lce la rgyu ba rengs na smra ba dka' ba dang*/ lce dang mchu rnams su thor pa 'ong ba dang*/ so na ba 'ong*/ dang po la rlung mgrin par bzung la lag mthil gyis 'phur zhing*/ lce'i rtsa bar yaṃ raṃ las me 'bar te/ ngag gi skyon thams cad bsregs par bsgom/ thor pa dang khrag gis mi bde ba la/ a ru ra/ mtshur nag /zhu mkhan gong 'dzam mi bskyod pa la sbyar te khar bzung*/ yun ring du song ba dang phyir pho la 'jibs nas chus bshal lo// khyad par du gags pa lta bu la/ rgya tshwa/ li shi/ me tog gsum pa'am/ de ma rnyed na lce tsha ba'am/ srub ka dang sbyar la gdab po// rlung gi so na ba la ni mi bskyod pa dron mo'am/ mar khu dron mo khar bzung ba'am/ yang na phying pa snum tshos dron mos mnan no// rlung srin la mkhan pa dang khyi'i spu mar du btsos la mnan no// mi ma yin pa'i rkyen gyis ngag mnan par gyur na/ rang yi dam rdo rje rtse lnga pa'am/ ral grir bsgoms la sngags kyi 'od me lta bus gnod byed bsregs par bsam ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bdag gi dag la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru swā hā/ zhes bzlas so// rdzas ni/ shu dag /ga bur/ gla rtsi/ mkhan pa a krong*/ phur mo mngar gsum dang sbyar nas ri lu byas te/ khar mur chus bshal lo// pags pa la rgyu ba rengs na/ za 'phrug la sogs pa pags pa'i nad du 'gyur te/ de bcos pa ni/ mi bskyod pa dron mos khrus bya (308)zhing*/ des ma phan na tshwa dang g.yer ma/ chur rtsa'i rtsa ba dud pa ma shor bar bsregs pa'i thal ba rnams zhib tu brdungs la/ mar nag gam/ mar gyi nang du btab la bskus shing nyi mas bsreg

/shu ba ru gyur na bdud rtsi'i phye ma mar khur btab la/ bdud rtsi chen po'i mar khu'am/ yang na dur byid dang chur rtsa thar nu gang 'dzom bsregs pa'i thal pa mar dang sbyar la bsku'o// pags pa'i bar du chu ser gyis gang nas skrangs na/ thog mar rlung hūm̐ gis dbyung ba mang du byas la/ phyir bus te seng ge rnam grol gyi phyag rgya bcas la drag tu sprug go /sman ni so ma rā dza ba'am mdzo mo'i dar ba gsar pa'am/ mi bskyod pas phul te za'o// 'dis ni sha lpags kyi mdze nad kyang sel lo// rma rnying dang*/ 'bras dang*/ phol mig dang*/ ser ka 'tshor med pa rnams la ni/ rlung bzung nas dmigs pa der gtad nas drag tu bcud de byang sems dkar dmar chu'i nang du 'thab pa la sems gtad/ dri chen/ sbyang brun/ khyi lud dkar po/ pa yag dang*/ lug thug gi rwa gzhob/ mi dang phag pa'i tshil rnams 'bru mar dang sbyar la bsku'o// des nges par 'tsho bar 'gyur ro// 'bras dang me dpal mdzer pa nag po'i rigs sha dang rus pa la zin cing nyung ma 'khyams pa lta bur gyur pa rnams la/ thar nu/ re lcag /spyang chor gsum gyi rtsa ba dri chen dri chu tshwa dud pa rnams sbyar la rma la bsku zhing*/ sdang ma'i lu mas su bcug la/ rjes thams cad chod nas shin tu tsha bar gyur pa dang*/ tshod bzung nas gong (309)gi sman gyis bskus na 'tsho bar 'gyur ro// 'brum nag la sogs pa 'brum pa'i nad la/ bya rkang gzugs pa'i 'khrul 'khor bcas la/ rlung kha sbyor du bzung la/ mnan zin nas 'gyel 'gyel du gcud cing rjes su mi bskyod pa la sran chung btab la/ thod pa'i nang du btags pa btung ngo*// de dag ni yan lag drug gi gegs sel 'phros dang bcas pa'o// sga skya/ drod sman 'jong mo/ bur dkar dang gsum bskol la/ ja sun tsam re/ nyin gcig thengs gnyis 'thungs na/ 'bu rnon la phan no// thig le'i gegs sel bstan pa ni/ rgyu rkyen ngos zin par bya ste/

dang po nyon mongs pa'i bag chags kyis 'dzag pa ni/ gnyen po theg pa thun mongs kyi thabs/ mi sdug pa bsgom pa rig pa kun rtags sam/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pa'i shes rab kyis so sor brtags nas/ sgyu ma lta bu'i stong pa nyid bsgom pa ste/ gsum po 'di gang zag gis blo rigs dang sbyar nas bsgom pa gal che/ gnyis pa thig le gdon gyis 'dzag pa ni/ rmi lam na/ rta dang*/ khyi dang*/ bud med la sogs pa rmi zhing*/ mi 'dod bzhin du 'dzag par 'gyur ro// de'i gnyen po ni spyir yi dam bsgom bzlas bya ba'am/ bye brag tu gtum mo bsgoms pa lta bu yin na/ phag mo mi bsgom na/ bdag nyid yi dam gang yin pa gnas gyur pa las/ pad ma nyi zla'i steng du byang chub sems dpa' ha nu man+da/ sku mdog dmar smug /zhal gcig phyag gnyis (310)pa/ g.yas na ri rab/ g.yon na ljon shing bsnams pa/ spyan bgrang cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags rdo rje'i rnam pa me 'bar ba/ rgyan med cing lus la ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba/ de'i gsang ba rdo rje rtse lnga pa me rab tu 'bar bas gnod byed bsregs par bsgoms la/ oṃ sidha ban ta ra mu kha/ oṃ bhe te bhe te/ ma bhe te ma bhe te/ ma bhi sha ma sa ma sa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzlas shing*/ de'i rjes la/ oṃ na shu kra dha ra ni bha dha mi si ha hi swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad re bzlas so// rdzas kyi bsrung ba byed na/ pad+ma rak+ta gtsang ma dang*/ sam sar zer ba'ang 'dug /byin brlabs can gyi dri chu dang*/ yungs kar bsregs pa'i thal ba dang*/ gu gul dang de rnams zhib tu btags te ril bu yungs kar tsam byas la gong gi shu kra'i sngags brgya'am/ stong ngam khri'am/ 'bum tshun chod bzlas te/ ril bu mi bskyod pa la sbyar dbang po'i sgo rnams su byug pa'am/ yang na ril bu re mid nas yi ge hrīḥme 'bar ba gcig tu gyur bar bsgoms na'ang zhag mang du bsrung ngo*// yang gzhon nu mas ba skal ba'i skud pa dkar po'am nag po la gong gi sngags bzlas nas sked pa la bcings na yang srung bar 'gyur ro// nad gzhi grang ba dang 'gram skyon gnyis las 'byung ba yod de/

grang pa la ni se 'bru/ sug smel/ pi pi ling*/ rgya tshwa/ rgyam tshwa/ kha ru tshwa/ mkhal ma zho sha /sdig srin/ bye ma/ sngo bre kha ba/ de rnams gang 'dzoms sbrang rtsi'am bu dkar la sbyar ba'i ril bu'am/ yang na rus (311)khus phul la btang*/ gcan gzan la sogs pa'i pags pa dron mos mkhal khung dang*/ sked pa la bcings pa'am/ yang na gdan dro bar bya/ kha zas bcud can btang*/ des kyang ma phan na/ gru mos sleb pa'i mkhal khung thad ka'i tshigs pa bcu bzhi pa'i g.yas g.yon du mtshon re gzhal ba'i sar byug chos bya ba'am/ yang na me btsa' bya/ des nges par sel bar 'gyur ro// brdabs pa la sogs pa'i 'gram pa la a ru ra/ brag zhun/ bre ga ba de rnams sbrang rtsi la sbyar la grang shas che na pi pi ling bsres la za'o// des nges par phan no// spyod lam gyis 'dzag pa ni/ ngal dub la sogs pa'i rkyen gang yin pa de/ cha mnyam pas sel bar 'gyur ro// de rnams ni phal pa rnams dang bcas pa spyi la 'byung ba'i gegs sel lo// khyad par du rtsa rlung bsgoms pas khams byang chub kyi sems rgyas par 'dzag pa rnams la/ dang po lus 'khrugs pa'i dus su bsrung ba byas pas don chung zhing*/ phyis gegs sel gyis mi phan par 'gyur ba yin pas/ rang sor klod la bzhag go /phyis lus thams cad du bde stobs rgyas shing thur du 'dzag na lus la bgram par bya ba gal che bas/ dang por rlung sbyangs te/ kha sna nas ha dang hūm̐ gis dbyung ba dang*/ dus gcig tu lus tsog pur byas te/ lto ba sgal pa la sbyar zhing 'og gi lam gsum gyen du 'then/ dmigs pa hūm̐ sngon po cig rtsa dbu ma nas smin mtshams su hril gyis (312)byung bar bsam/ yang nang du rngubs nas lto ba bgang zhing 'og tu phul nas hūm̐ de dbu ma'i mas snar thal te byung bar bsam/ de ltar rlung byang nas/ dmigs pa gtad pa tsam gyis 'dren thub pas 'khrul 'khor gang gis kyang phan no// mi shes na 'di ltar byas te/

lus tsog bu'am/ skyil krung gang bde la/ lag pa'i srin lag gi rtsa mthe bong gis mnan la/ khu tshur bcangs te mdun du bsnol ba ltar byas nas/ de nas sngar ltar rlung bzung zhing*/ dang po steng rlung non par mnan la/ de nas 'og rlung yang drag tu 'then pa dang dus gcig tu lto ba sgal pa la sbyar/ lce yar kan la sbyar/ mchu dang mig gyen la bzlog /mdun dang g.yas g.yon du lus phar gcu tshur gcu bya zhing*/ res mos kyis drangs te/ dmigs pa ni/ hūm̐ gis thig le thams cad drangs/ smin phrag tu thim pa la shes pa gtad de drag 'dren yin no// dal bus 'dren na skyil krung bcas pa'i bus mo la lag mthil gtad nas gzhan rlung sbyor 'dren lugs snga ma bzhin du dal bus kyi/ des ni steng du drangs par nus pas de nas dgram pa ni/ lus drag tu sprug pa dang 'phur ba kho nas chog pa shas che la/ gal te des ma chog na gan rkyal du nyal la/ rkang pa dang lag pa re mos su sprug pa dang 'phur bas khyab par 'gyur ro// de ltar byas pas steng lce chung gi dbus su 'dzag na/ seng ge rnam grol gyi phyag rgya byas te/ rlung phyir bzung nas gnad du 'gro bar bya'o// 'ga' zhig la byang grags pa'i stobs (313)kyis/ gong gis 'khrul 'khor gyis mi phan pa yod de/ de la dbu ma'i mas snar dgag dgos pas bgrang ba'i mtha' bsrung ba zhes bya ba/ 'og gi rtsa sgo rkang pa g.yon pa'i rting pas mnan la/ thig le rlung gis thur du phul zhing*/ bar gyi rlung thad kar brgyangs nas yun ring du ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag cing de nyid brtan par bya/ 'di rnams ni byang chub sems kyi gegs sel yin no// brten pa sems las byung ba'i gegs sel ni/ gong du bshad pa nyid la tshang zhing*/ gzhan yang thun che chung kha zas dbri skyed/ dmigs pa sgrim lhod rnams spel ba dang*/ sems kyi gnad sna tshogs su 'pho ba dang*/ yul sna tshogs kyi bdud rtsi bsten pa dang*/

bla ma la mos gus dang*/ chos la yid ches kyi dad pa dang*/ 'gro ba la snying rje dang*/ chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur shes pas/ sems kyi gegs las rang sar grol bar 'gyur ro// gegs sel thor bu sna tshogs bsdus pa'i sde tshan te lnga pa'o// de ltar na gegs sel gyi yi ge 'di yang*/ brgyud pa'i bla ma gong ma so so'i man ngag gi yi ge bzhin du phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa yin la/ 'ga' zhig la nyams myong gis kyang cung zad brgyan pa ste/ nags rgyal gyi dben gnas jo nang du tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// la stod dbang rgyal dang*/ sren lugs kyi gegs sel mang du yod pa ni de rnams kyi gsung du blta bar bya'o/// /(314)
